The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 4. Generic Staggered Delivery: The ordered items shall be supplied in a staggered manner. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 3/4 OF SHELF LIFE Shelf Life. Financial Standing of the Bidder It is hereby stipulated that the Bidder shall not be under liquidation, court receivership, insolvency, or any similar legal proceedings. The Bidder shall not be bankrupt as on the date of bid submission. An undertaki ng to this effect, duly signed by the authorized signatory of the Bidder, must be uploaded along with the bi d. 2. Goods and Services Tax (GST) Bidders are advised to verify the applicable rate of GST on their own prior to quoting the prices. The Buyer shall not be responsible for any discrepancy in the GST rate quoted by the Bidder. Reimbursement of GST shall be made as per the actual rate applicable or the quoted GST percentage, whichever is lower, subject to the ceiling of the quoted GST rate. 3. Scope of Supply The scope of supply shall be limited to the supply of goods only, and the bid price shall be inclusive of all c

ost components, including but not limited to, packing, forwarding, freight, insurance, and all applicable sta tutory charges. 4. Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Clause In case of imported products, the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or the authorized representative of the OEM must have a registered office in India to provide after-sales service support. A certificate to thi s effect, duly signed and stamped by the OEM, shall be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Service and Support The Bidder/OEM shall furnish a detailed Escalation Matrix containing names, designations, and telephone n umbers of concerned officials responsible for service support, to ensure prompt redressal of issues. 6. Certificates and Licenses To be eligible for award of the contract, the Bidder/OEM must possess and upload the following valid certifi cates/documents as on the date of bid opening: · Copy of valid Manufacturing License / Drug License. 7. Forms of EMD and Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) a. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): Bidders may submit the EMD through an Account Payee Demand Draft or Banker's Cheque drawn in favour of “ESIC Fund Account No.1”, payable at Faridabad. The Bidder must upload a scanned copy of the instru ment along with the bid and ensure that the original hard copy reaches the Buyer within five (5) days of th e bid end/opening date. b. Performance Security: The successful Bidder may furnish the Performance Security either in the form of a Bank Guarantee (as per GeM GTC) or an Account Payee Demand Draft drawn in favour of “ESIC Fund Account No.1”, payable at Far idabad. The scanned copy shall be uploaded, and the original DD must be delivered to the Buyer within fift een (15) days of award of contract. The duration of PBG shall last 2 (two) months over expiry date of medicines supplied. 8. Staggered Delivery The Schedule for the staggered delivery is mentioned in item specification document. Seller must note that the initial quantity to be delivered is the quantity to be delivered within 1 to 15 days. For rest of quantity, delivery should be made as per buyer requirement only. Buyer department shall make communication regarding delivery of such remaining stock and provide exte nsion of delivery period without liquidated damages for a delivery period of 10 days. If seller fails to provide the staggered delivery item within 10 days or higher specified item as buyer's discr etion, liquidated damages shall be applicable. NB: Buyer department shall not be responsible for payment of any extra/early delivered items. Quarter Allocation (%) Q1 25% of Bid Quantity 25% of Bid Quantity Q2

Q3 25% of Bid Quantity Q4 25% of Bid Quantity Total 100% 9. Replacement of Unconsumed Stock The Bidder shall furnish an undertaking that any unconsumed stock within its shelf life shall be replaced wi th fresh batch at no additional cost to the Buyer. 10. Price Undertaking The Bidder shall also submit an undertaking confirming that if there is any downward revision in the marke t price of the quoted product during the contract period, the same shall be intimated to the institution, and the benefit of such reduction shall be passed on to the Buyer. The quoted rates shall remain valid for a period of one (1) year from the date of issuance of the Purchase Order/Contract. 12. Documents to be Uploaded In addition to the documents prescribed under GeM norms, the following documents must be uploaded: a. Copy of Chartered Accountant Certificate (with UDIN) indicating the minimum average annual turnover of the Bidder for the last three financial years (2023–24, 2024–25, 2025–26). b. Similar certificate for the OEM / Principal Manufacturer, along with balance sheets for the same period. c. Copy of valid Drug License of the bidder. d. Copy of GMP / Manufacturing License of the OEM on demand. e. Authorization Letter from the OEM addressed to the Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, NIT-3, Farida bad, clearly mentioning the bid number and date. h. Acceptance of Terms & Conditions as prescribed in the ATC document. 13. Pricing and Delivery · Rates shall be quoted per unit as reflected in the GeM BOQ/custom bid, inclusive of all applicable taxe s, duties, transportation, and delivery charges, on FOR ESIC MCH Faridabad NIT-3 Haryana. · Supplies must be completed within the stipulated delivery period; no extension shall ordinarily be gra nted. · All goods must be legibly marked “ESIC SUPPLY - NOT FOR SALE” in indelible ink. Supplies not confor ming to this requirement shall be rejected. 14. Quality and Inspection Each batch of drugs supplied must be accompanied by a Certificate of Analysis/Test Report issued by a NA BL Accredited or Central Drug Testing Laboratory. Supplies lacking such reports shall not be accepted, and payment shall be withheld. The procuring authority reserves the right to subject any batch to further testin g at its discretion during the shelf life of the product. All expenses incurred will be recoverable and the wh ole lot has to be replaced if NSQ comes out of drug testing. 15. Packaging, Transport, and Risk The supplier shall ensure proper packing of goods to prevent damage during transit by air, rail, or road. An y loss or damage discovered upon inspection at the consignee's store shall be made good by the supplier

at no extra cost. The department shall not be liable for any insurance charges; such costs shall be borne b y the supplier. 16. Shelf Life All drugs/medicines supplied must have at least three-fourths (¾) of their shelf life remaining at the time o f receipt at the stores. 17. Right to Reserve Competent authority reserves right return the reagent and consumable if they remain unutilized or revoke contract at any period of time if goods are not satisfactory and will be return at cost of qualified bidder. 18. Expiry If any Drug expired in the hospital the same to be replaced by the qualified Bidder free of cost. Bidder has to submit “near relative financial interest declaration clause”. If the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller or any employee of the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller or any pers on acting on behalf of the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller, either directly or indirectly, is a relative of any officers/officials (regular/contractual) of Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), or alternatively, if any relative of an officer/official of ESIC has financial interest/stake in the bidder's/contractor's/supplier's/s eller's firm, the same shall be disclosed by the bidder/contractor/supplier/seller at the time of filing of the t ender/participation in the procurement process. Failure to disclose this shall result in cancellation of the bi dder's participation. 19. Turn over limit will be assessed by total estimated value of quoted schedule as follows: Bidder: 50% in case of bidder OEM: 100% in case of OEM 8. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any). 9. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer's right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy ava ilable to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, an action on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the P urchase Order on the Seller. .
